notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Warlock's Tower players![/h1]

One quick announcement: last night we did a small update to the game, to fix some minor bugs which were affecting later stages. Stages Library B, 7 and Chambers A, 8 having been updated, as well as some of the logic concerning the jars and monsters behavior.

Things should be A-OK right now. And if they're not, please let us know! :)

Your faithful mailman,
Tim
[img]http://i.giphy.com/l2JhI3GSgqw3aSqVW.gif[/img]

notes.title: ...and Warlock's Tower is out!
notes.content:
.


[h1]The biggest of news postal people: we're live![/h1]

Warlock's Tower is now available for your purchasing pleasure. The cursed tower, full countless brainteasing and devilishly clever puzzles, awaits you.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26347823/82778090b1c15fb17eefb1d038750a3c4323b402.gif[/img]

We believe we have a nice game now ready for you, made with love, pixel by pixel! We're very pleased with how it's turned out and hope you enjoy it too. 

Also, if you're up for it, please spread the word that Warlock's Tower is now out! Every little bit helps. 

As always, thank you!
Tim
[img]http://i.giphy.com/l2JhI3GSgqw3aSqVW.gif[/img]

notes.title: tomorrow is LAUNCH day!
notes.content:
.

[h1]Tomorrow is the big day postal people![/h1]

Warlock's Tower will be available tomorrow at 11am PST for $9.99 USD. We've had a big week leading up to launch. He had a Twitch broadcast go down with Vuxxy that got front page placement on Twitch, which was very cool. You can check out the (time sensitive) recording here: 

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/117845458] [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26347823/c4b4e227943217d0c8892e91b75fd34699ff230a.png[/img] [/url]

Also, we spent the weekend exhibiting Warlock's Tower at PAX South. People really dug Warlock's Tower and it was a very good (and busy!) time. Check out a few pics below. 

We're excited, anxious, and all that good stuff heading into tomorrow. If you're digging Warlock's Tower and are up for spreading the news, we'd really appreciate you talking about it on the social webs and whatnot.

Thanks and see all TOMORROW!
Tim
[img]http://i.giphy.com/l2JhI3GSgqw3aSqVW.gif[/img]

[u]PAX SOUTH[/u]

notes.title: Warlock's Tower shipping in one week!
notes.content:
.


[h1]Howdy postal people![/h1]

One week! We are exactly one week out from launch. Warlock's Tower will be live and available for sale on Tues, Jan 31st at 11am PST. Exciting stuff!.

Here is a little taste of what you'll find in some of the later levels:

[img]http://i.giphy.com/l3q2uR47yfgNuamvS.gif[/img]

Also, last week the good folks at [b]Polygon[/b] streamed Warlock's Tower on fb live! It was fun to see the stream chat give tips and instructions one each puzzle (if only this was done on Twitch!!!). Check it out here:

[url=https://www.facebook.com/polygon/videos/1425498974129393/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26347823/16c7bb33bbee43fd71deb2a4f73ec3c3430663d0.png[/img][/url]

Thanks and see you VERY soon!
Tim
[img]http://i.giphy.com/l2JhI3GSgqw3aSqVW.gif[/img]

notes.title: Launch Date & Launch Trailer
notes.content:
[h1]Big news today fellow postal people![/h1]

We're stoked to announce Warlock's Tower will be launching on [b]Tuesday, January 31st[/b]. That's only three weeks away. Oh yeah! 

We have a new trailer - the final release trailer - hot and fresh out of the oven. Check it out:

https://youtu.be/yj_pQvwD8FM

We had a lot we wanted to show in the trailer but attention spans are short so we decided to mainly highlight:
[list]
[*]awards received to-date
[*]the simple and devilish 'one step equals one life lost' design
[*]monsters!
[*]levels you can tag team with your companion Jess
[*]the Twitch integration, including live shots from Orangesherbet's stream from a couple weeks back
[/list]
To commemorate these events, we have one of the newer and more difficult puzzle rooms to share so you can start planning your strategy and moves now. Watch your step!

[img]http://i.giphy.com/3o7TKv0gsiX95dFD7a.gif[/img]

Thank you all!
Tim
[img]http://i.giphy.com/l2JhI3GSgqw3aSqVW.gif[/img]

notes.title: Warlock's Tower at Rio Indie Games Festival
notes.content:
[h1]Hey there fellow post people! [/h1]

This past weekend Warlock's Tower participated in the Rio Indie Game Festival as one of the finalist games. We didn't take home the grand prize but it was still a great show.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26347823/9875772d4321eae3dc9d62d391e96c95e482c7bc.jpg[/img]


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26347823/99f9d4fc0e43da1b8f038425922d73f6c5caed9c.jpg[/img]

In addition to exhibiting at the festival, we also made solid progress this week on our dev task list and on the Warlock's Tower <--> Twitch integration. On the latter, we're hoping to have something to share with you [b]very soon![/b]

Thanks!
Tim
[img]http://i.giphy.com/l2JhI3GSgqw3aSqVW.gif[/img]

notes.title: Twitch, Beta, Interview, & Achievements
notes.content:
[img]http://i.giphy.com/3oz8xsKUsayxeCvPhK.gif[/img]

[h1]Hello fellow postal people![/h1]We've had a productive couple weeks and wanted to share a few updates:

[h1]TWITCH[/h1]This is a big one! We just broke ground on what we hope will be a really fun and compelling Warlock's Tower <--> Twitch integration. We've identified an cool way for a broadcaster to play along with his/her audience and we're hoping to have additional news to share here in the coming weeks. Stay tuned!

[h1]BETA TESTING[/h1]It's going well. Which good news! We are pretty good on the amount of testers at the moment but if you'd like to throw your hat into the ring in the event we open it back up, here is the [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScPkx5d5JPf6SHSQ5ijTTaAOCgNtfT7yo2PLjac1FwIjpFD_g/viewform?c=0&w=1]short form[/url]. You'll get your name in the credits!

[h1]INTERVIEW[/h1]As you may know, Warlock's Tower will also be shipping on the 3DS and our very own Werther Azevedo sat down for an interview with the folks over at Miketendo64 to chat about the game, his background, and more. Check it out [url=https://miketendo64.com/2016/11/15/midipixel-studio-a-miketendo64-interview-warlocks-tower/]here[/url]. It's good stuff!

[h1]ACHIEVEMENTS[/h1]
The first set of Steam Achievements are starting to roll off the assembly line and we wanted show them off. As more get finalized, we'll continue to share them here. Check the first batch out!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26347823/a6195c61f0dec86989fbc43f33d47d38a21f9b8e.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26347823/cc338bb17f8422651ab325e2f2bc674e7f2b2095.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26347823/7e9d74476142a63bd0bd9600c3d48924d49e98fd.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26347823/694947e93dd004ad88805c1f90053965669bf3cc.gif[/img]


Thanks all!
Tim
[img]http://i.giphy.com/l2JhI3GSgqw3aSqVW.gif[/img]

notes.title: Join our Beta testing team & get your name in the credits!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26347823/4d8f76ef8e93ecb1c17d1c9d00bc54f3cd2aeb2a.gif[/img]

[h1]Howdy fellow postal people![/h1]

Thank you all for you interest in [b]Warlock's Tower[/b]! We are working away and making great progress towards the January launch. 

To that end, we are looking for folks to help beta test Warlock's Tower in the near future. If you're a generous and brave soul who participates, we'll happily add your name to the game's credits as part of the testing team! ːsteamhappyː

If interested, please knock out [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScPkx5d5JPf6SHSQ5ijTTaAOCgNtfT7yo2PLjac1FwIjpFD_g/viewform] this short form[/url] and we'll be in touch shortly.

Also, keep your eyes peeled here as we'll be providing updates - from the beta to screenshots to GIFs to maybe (shhhhh) even giveaways - regularly from here on out.

Thanks again!

Tim
[img]http://i.giphy.com/l2JhI3GSgqw3aSqVW.gif[/img]
